newsitem.title: UK: N Sea Forties crude firmer, paper markets quiet.
newsitem.headline: N Sea Forties crude firmer, paper markets quiet.

text.p: Traders said they were surprised by Monday's Forties deals at a firmer Dated Brent +6 cents but argued that other sweet grades for April loading were still under pressure.
Two million barrels of end April Forties changed hands at dated Brent +6 cents.
'It's a surprisingly high number,' one said.
Sellers pointed out that 600Kb cargoes carried a premium as they gave buyers a freight advantage.
An April 23-25 minimum sized cargo of Brent crude oil was bought by a refiner at May Brent -55 cents.
Five cargoes of April loading Statfjord were still unsold, traders said. Four of these were loading in the April 20-25 period.
Intermonth spreads held steady despite gains on outright levels following the NYMEX gasoline lead.
Brent May/June talked around -23/-21 cents after an early trade at -20 cents. June/July traded at -11 cents and July/Aug moved twice at -9 cents and once at -10 cents.
After loosing ground early on, CFD's held at lower levels in thin trade. This week (April 14-18) moved at June Brent -67 cents, while April 21-25 moved at June -58 cents.
The week 28-02 week sold at June -53 cents.
The May Brent programme was expected to be released early on Tuesday.
